Scenario: Chills run down your spine as you open the entrance to your tent to use the bathroom and are greeted by a pale blue specter wearing camo fatigues and a raccoon cap.
Log Version: I encountered a blue specter outside my tent!

Scenario: You feel an unsettling presence behind you as you're dousing your campfire and quickly turn your head to witness the ghost of a headless huntswoman astride a silver steed.
Log Version: I encountered the ghost of a headless huntswoman at my campsite!

Scenario: Your skin prickles as you see a shape through the trees just beyond your tent - a woman in a long <white/black/blue> dress. The sound of her weeping shatters the midnight silence into pieces.
Log Version: I saw the ghost of a weeping woman just beyond my campsite!

Scenario: You wake up early in the morning to the sound of a woman's <unearthly/unnatural> shrieking. Though you can't see anything, you feel an impending sense of doom.
Log Version: I heard a banshee shrieking during the night!

Scenario: You're scrubbing out your campfire cookware in a nearby stream when you suddenly notice, just below the surface, a formless water wraith with the faint suggestion of a human face.
Log Version: I encountered a wraith in a stream by my campsite!

Scenario: You hear what you think is a <raccoon/possum/fox> in your campsite during the night, but when you stick your head out the tent flap, you see the poltergeist of a small boy throwing around your <food supplies/toilet kit/backpack contents/camping dishes/fire starting supplies>.
Log Version: I saw a poltergeist messing with my camping supplies!

Scenario: As you approach the latrine at your campsite, you witness a <gray/black/white>, spectral figure of <a little boy/a middle-aged man/an elderly man> <hovering/squatting> over the hole, groaning in pain.
Log Version: I walked in on the ghost of <rb2> using the camp latrine!

Scenario: You went to sleep tucked safely in your sleeping bag but then woke up paralyzed with a dark shape sitting on your chest, pressing the air out of your lungs.
Log Version: I was visited by a night hag in my tent!

Scenario: While blissfully dozing off in your camp chair, you're suddenly awoken by a strange figure asking who you are, and it looks, walks, and talks just like you.
Log Version: I was awoken by an otherworldly mimic at my campsite!

Scenario: You're putting out your campfire, and as the steam from the hissing coals clears, you see the figure of a distressed young woman <with red lipstick/wearing an old-fashioned hat/in a wedding dress/in a fur coat/dressed in rags>. She asks if you've seen her <locket/wedding ring/diamond bracelet/engagement ring/pearl earrings/emerald choker/ruby brooch>.
Log Version: I saw the ghost of a distressed young woman looking for her <rb2>!

Scenario: You fall asleep to the gentle sounds of rain on your tent, and wake up in the middle of the night to see the specter of a hiker sitting in the corner. He asks if he can stay out of the rain in your shelter, and when you nod, he smiles.
Log Version: I was visited by the specter of hiker seeking shelter from the rain!

Scenario: You're watching the sun go down while roasting s'mores over your campfire. As the last sunlight vanishes, you see the ghostly figure of a woman covered in blood, holding a crimson <knife/sword/dagger/katana/scythe/axe/machete/hatchet>.
Log Version: I saw the ghost of a bloody woman holding a crimson <rb>!

Scenario: While chatting with some other campers, you learn there's a <cemetery/graveyard> nearby. Later, as you're exploring, you see a skeleton rise up from behind a tombstone and regard you with glowing <red/blue/green/white/yellow/orange/magenta/purple> eyes.
Log Version: I ran across an animated skeleton with glowing <rb> eyes!

Scenario: While you're setting up your tent, you hear a commotion behind you. When you turn, you see the spirit of an enthusiastic little girl who asks if you want to see her do <a crazy dance move/a cartwheel/a handstand/the worm/a sick flip/a magic trick>.
Log Version: I saw the spirit of a little girl who wanted to show me <rb>!

Scenario: You come back from heeding the call of nature and see the apparition of a man <in military uniform/in a firefighter's uniform/in a chef's apron/in old-fashioned servant's clothes/in farmer's overalls/in a suit and tie/in a prisoner's jumpsuit/in a priest's collar> vengefully flinging fiery coals all over your campsite.
Log Version: I saw a poltergeist flinging fiery coals in my campsite!

Scenario: You've nodded off in your camping chair but are awoken by a light shining into your face. A translucent figure stands at the edge of the clearing, wearing mining clothes and an eerily bright headlamp.
Log Version: I witnessed a ghostly miner approach me while I was camping!

Scenario: You wake up after a night of tossing and turning to discover your campsite is blanketed in heavy fog. A ball of flickering light hovers at the edge, as if beckoning you into the mist.
Log Version: I encountered a will-o'-the-wisp that tried to beck me into the fog!

Scenario: You're cutting some kindling with your camp saw when you see, out of the corner of your eye, a woman in a prim dress and a <red/yellow/blue/green/black/white/pink/lavender> ribbon around her neck.
Log Version: I saw the ghost of a woman with a <rb> ribbon around her neck!

Scenario: You wake up in the middle of the night and feel an odd energy. When you lift your tent flap, you see the specter of a depressed-looking man holding a <skull/suitcase/jeweled crown/bouquet of dead flowers/rubber chicken/condom packet/cup of coffee/violin>.
Log Version: I came across the specter of a depressed man holding a <rb>!

Scenario: You're staring at the reflection of the moon in a small pond near your campsite when you notice a dark figure over your shoulder. You turn, but the figure is only visible in the reflection of the water.
Log Version: I saw a dark spirit standing behind my reflection near my campsite!

Scenario: You've just finished setting up your tent when you hear a voice behind you and turn to see the ghost of a teenage boy asking if you've seen his pet <dog/cat/fox/possum/raccoon/squirrel>.
Log Version: I met the ghost of a teenage boy looking for his pet <rb>!
